note: Parts are authored in the base palette, where every role is a different block. A palette is a map from role to block: to recolour a part, replace each base block with the palette's block for the same role (stairs and slabs keep their states when the target is a stair or slab; a full block drops them).

roles.beam: horizontal frame: sills, girts, lintels, the gable's tie beam
roles.brace: brackets under jetties and decorative braces
roles.floor: floors and the ceiling under the roof
roles.chimney: chimney stack, from the hearth through the roof
roles.band: the girt band at each floor and its corner returns (a half slab)
roles.board: studs as boards on the daub (an open trapdoor)

stone.note: the base: stone ground storey, white daub above, red-brown tile; corner houses and the forum

daub.note: the village default: dark oak frame, white daub on both storeys, thatch

brick.note: the town's better houses and halls: brick nogging, slate roof

inherit: A palette lists only the roles it changes; the rest come from the base.
